description: Budgets for startup to first frame, presented-frame intervals and RSS. A value exists only where a run on that lane produced it. Fields marked unmeasured hold no number.

method.ceilingRule: ceiling = ceil(baseline.max * regressionFactor), written by scripts/validate-budgets.mjs --apply-baseline
method.checkRule: A host check runs the workload hostRunsPerCheck times and compares the median of each metric with its ceiling. A median above the ceiling fails the lane.
method.frameInterval: Gaps between consecutive QQuickWindow::frameSwapped instants that fall between the first and last posted wheel notch. At least 30 swaps must fall in that window. A swap is the end of a scene-graph swap, not a display presentation.
method.startup: steady_clock from the first statement of main() to the first frameSwapped after the surface started. Excludes dynamic loading before main().
method.rss: peakRssKiB from the OS after the run (Linux VmHWM, macOS ru_maxrss).
method.invalidRun: A result with droppedFrames above 0, a missing RSS, or too few swaps in the window is rejected, never averaged in.
method.changePolicy: A ceiling does not change without an ADR and the owner. --apply-baseline refuses to raise a measured ceiling.

knownConstraints.effect: Hermes runs as an interpreter in every build here, host and QNX. Every budget in this file was measured without a JIT. A budget would need a new measurement and an ADR if that setting changes.
